name: relationship-manager
description: Agent-native relationship manager — one graph of the people you actually talk to, from your own email, WhatsApp, calendar and calls. MCP + REST + CLI from one tool contract.

scripts.seed:push: for f in packages/seed/out/seed-*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute relationship-manager --remote --file "$f"; done

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

COMPOSIO_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets the Connections screen sign in to Gmail, Google Calendar and Fathom, and sync them from the cloud.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional. Comma-separated addresses allowed to create an account — without it, only the first account ever exists.
